decisions.reason: After two years this adjacent fin-cooler still looks inexpensive to maintain within the core portfolio, and while uncertainty has narrowed there is not enough evidence of weak value to justify abandonment yet.

This condenser remains close to the established business and worth keeping for another year, but the case for later pruning has strengthened because the firm now has more time to judge overlap among similar condenser options.

With two similar new condenser offers having been tested for two years, management would now rationalize the weaker or less differentiated option and reallocate attention to the better-supported variant and new development.

The customized multi-model air-cooler line fits the firm's integrated-solution strategy especially well, so its strategic option value remains high relative to the likely low cost of keeping it on the market.
These repair inserts still complement the lifecycle-service model and are relatively cheap to carry, so the firm would continue learning from service demand rather than exit now.
